title: Maybe we should have called it a day.
intro: The walls were moving forward. The last piece of paneling had other ideas.
needles: I made a bad measurement and ruined a piece of paneling
Another ruined piece of paneling.
Looking back, maybe we should have used that last day
nextlabel: More of the builds, including the ones that fight back
source_paragraphs: I made a bad measurement and ruined a piece of paneling, so we decided to call it quits for the day.
Another ruined piece of paneling.
Looking back, maybe we should have used that last day, which was cooler and really beautiful, to just relax and enjoy what we had already accomplished.

title: A little set of stairs made the next job easier.
intro: Before the cabin walls, the storage shed needed a better way in.
needles: But before we could get to the walls, we needed stairs
Nothing fancy, just one of those practical little jobs
source_paragraphs: But before we could get to the walls, we needed stairs on that ugly green storage shed.
Nothing fancy, just one of those practical little jobs that instantly makes everything around it work better.

title: Yup. Harry was back.
intro: Some of the best moments happen before the tools come out.
needles: Yup. Harry was back.
And not only was Harry back
We think we were seeing Harry
It is funny how much you miss those little critters
nextlabel: A little practical help for your own feeder
source_paragraphs: Yup. Harry was back.
And not only was Harry back, we were pretty sure he brought family with him.
We think we were seeing Harry, Harriet, and one of their kids.
It is funny how much you miss those little critters when they are gone.

title: Time to get those berry trellises into the ground.
intro: A small workshop project finally joined the raspberry and blackberry patch.
needles: A week earlier, I had built a couple of trellises
source_paragraphs: A week earlier, I had built a couple of trellises for the raspberries and blackberries. Now it was finally time to get them installed and start training those plants to climb toward the sky.

title: Another try for the beds back home.
intro: The cabin was waking up. Back in the city, we had another garden problem to work on.
needles: Back in the city, we caught a nice day
Let’s build some and see if we can actually keep our city vegetables alive
source_paragraphs: Back in the city, we caught a nice day and started refreshing our raised garden beds. We were determined not to kill everything we planted this year, so I did a little research and found ollas.
Let’s build some and see if we can actually keep our city vegetables alive this time.

title: Everybody took a birdhouse home.
intro: A winter project turned into Vanessa’s Christmas Sip & Build.
needles: We ended up hosting her work party
And honestly, that was a blast.
Everybody had fun, we had fun
source_paragraphs: We ended up hosting her work party here, and everyone got to build and decorate a birdhouse. We called it her Christmas Sip & Build.
And honestly, that was a blast.
Everybody had fun, we had fun, and they all got to take home their own special birdhouse.

title: We missed the grapes.
intro: There were some small harvests that season. The grapes were not one of them.
needles: We did manage to get a few vegetables though
lose every single grape
There had been thousands of them.
And in just a few short days while we were gone
I guess the critters, and maybe the birds too
nextlabel: The garden story includes the setbacks
source_paragraphs: We did manage to get a few vegetables though, along with strawberries, blueberries, some apples, and pears.
But I’ll be damned if we did not lose every single grape.
There had been thousands of them.
And in just a few short days while we were gone, they were wiped out.
I guess the critters, and maybe the birds too, liked them even more than we did.

title: The chairs came out pretty quickly.
intro: After the measuring, hauling, digging, and screws, the deck started earning its place.
needles: And once it was done, it did not take us long
That part might have been the best reward of all.
nextlabel: See how the deck changed our time outside
source_paragraphs: And once it was done, it did not take us long at all to drag out a couple of chairs and start enjoying this new addition to peaceful cabin life.
That part might have been the best reward of all.
